url.label: Target URL *
url.tooltip: The HTTP(S) endpoint to test. Must include protocol (http:// or https://).
url.error: URL must start with http:// or https://

method.label: HTTP Method
method.tooltip: HTTP method to use for requests. GET for fetching data, POST/PUT for sending data.

rate.label: Rate
rate.tooltip: Request rate: REQUESTS/TIME. Examples: 100/1s (100 per second), 1000/1m (1000 per minute), 50/500ms (50 per 500ms). Units: ms, s, m, h.

duration.label: Duration
duration.tooltip: How long to run the test. Enter 0 for infinite duration (stop manually with Stop button). Examples: 30s, 5m, 1h, or just 0.

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.tooltip: Maximum time to wait for each request response. If exceeded, request is marked as failed. Examples: 10s, 30s, 1m.

workers.label: Workers
workers.tooltip: Number of concurrent goroutines sending requests. More workers = more parallel requests. Recommended: 10-100 for most tests.

connections.label: Connections
connections.tooltip: Maximum number of TCP connections to keep open. Higher values allow more parallel requests but use more resources. Recommended: equal to or higher than workers.

body.label: Request Body
body.tooltip: JSON or text body to send with each request. Leave empty for no body. Content-Type defaults to application/json.

headers.label: Headers
headers.tooltip: Custom HTTP headers to send with each request. Format: Header-Name: value. Press Enter or click Add to add a header.

grpcTarget.label: Target *
grpcTarget.tooltip: gRPC server address in host:port format, e.g. localhost:50051

grpcService.label: Service *
grpcService.tooltip: Fully qualified service name, e.g. helloworld.Greeter

grpcMethod.label: Method *
grpcMethod.tooltip: RPC method name without dots, e.g. SayHello

grpcData.label: Request Data (JSON)
grpcData.tooltip: JSON payload sent with each request. Leave as {} for empty message.

grpcProto.label: Proto File
grpcProto.tooltip: Upload a local .proto file. Leave empty to use server reflection.

grpcMetadata.label: gRPC Metadata
grpcMetadata.tooltip: Key-value metadata sent with each request. Format: key:value.

insecure.label: Insecure (skip TLS)
insecure.tooltip: Disable TLS certificate verification. Use for local testing only.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.noMetricsHint: Start an attack to see real-time metrics
metrics.noNetworkErrors: No network errors. {{count}} request(s) failed with HTTP error codes (see Status Codes).
